date.source: The results post is dated 18 June 2011; its card was posted on 7 June.

evidence.note: The first show of the return in play-by-play: changes announced by the General Manager, two title matches, an exhibition fatal four way and the nine-man match for the world title.
The card for this show, posted on 7 June; the General Manager changed two matches in the ring.

matches.stipulation: Single match for the TV Championship
matches.finish: Underkane hit an Angle Slam on Candres and covered him to win the TV Championship in his first match.
matches.note: Billed on the card as Panchito against Candres; the General Manager announced Underkane in his place.

matches.stipulation: Single match for the Intercontinental Championship
matches.finish: After Makaveli powerslammed the referee, Panchito hit him with a chain and an Attitude Adjustment, and a second referee counted three; Panchito won the Intercontinental Championship in his first match.
matches.note: The General Manager moved Panchito here after reporting that Euraiden, billed for a triple threat for the title, had not come to the arena. Awesome Mizanin attacked Panchito afterwards and said the title would soon be his.

matches.finish: Shaw Xtreme eliminated Daniel Bryan and then Victor, and CM Monster beat him with a GTS to win the match; Icon came out to help Shaw until the General Manager ordered him out.
matches.note: Billed as an exhibition; the card asked the players for promos that would count as points.

eliminations.note: Sweet Chin Music and a cover.
A Frog Splash after Icon's interference.

matches.stipulation: Nine-man Elimination Match for the PWA World Championship (no disqualification)
matches.finish: Criki Pedigreed Rated HBK, then caught Master with a super Pedigree and covered him to win the PWA World Championship.
matches.note: The main event. Frank took the microphone first to say the match was void because he had been champion when PWA closed. Layla was at ringside.

eliminations.note: Gave up after a Pedigree from Criki and holds from Victor, CM Monster and Evil Hart.
Gave up to an Anaconda Vise.
Gave up to an angle lock.
A Pedigree after Criki turned on his partner.

date.source: The results post is dated 2 July 2011; its card was posted on 19 June.

evidence.note: The second show in play-by-play from the Citrus Bowl: a walkover, a TV title defence, a non-title match, two contender matches and the tag team ladder match.
The card for this show, posted on 19 June.

matches.stipulation: Single match for the TV Championship
matches.finish: Underkane made Daniel Bryan give up to an ankle lock in the middle of the ring and kept the TV Championship.
Panchito, the Intercontinental Champion, turned Mizanin's lock into an STFU in the middle of the ring and Mizanin gave up.

matches.stipulation: No Disqualification Match for the position of challenger for the Intercontinental Championship
matches.finish: Evil Hart knocked Euraiden out with a Canadian Destroyer, escaped Makaveli's Dr Bomb and put him in a Figure Four; Makaveli gave up and Evil Hart became Panchito's challenger.
matches.note: Billed on the card as Evil Hart against Adam Zero and Makaveli; the results have Euraiden in the match from the bell and do not mention Adam Zero.

matches.stipulation: Match for the position of number one contender to the PWA World Heavyweight Championship
matches.finish: Rated HBK hit God of Dark with an RKO and covered him; Criki came out and Pedigreed Rated HBK afterwards.
matches.note: Billed on the card as a fatal four way with The Lightning Hero and Frank.

matches.stipulation: Tag Team Ladder Match for the Tag Team Championships
matches.finish: After Rated HBK came out and hit Victor with an RKO, Icon climbed the ladder and unhooked the belts; Icon and Shaw Xtreme became the Tag Team Champions.
matches.note: The main event. Layla was at ringside with CM Monster.
